versions.content: function IndicateMessage [SWS_DM_00309] Upstream: RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00121 , RS_AP_00122 , RS_Diag_04147 , RS_Diag_04168 virtual std::pair < IndicationResult , UdsMessagePtr > IndicateMessage ( UdsMessage::Address sourceAddr, UdsMessage::Address targetAddr, Uds Message:: TargetAddressType type, GlobalChannelIdentifier globalChannel Id, std::size_t size, ara::core::Span < const std::uint8_t > payload Info) noexcept=0; Indicates a message start. This is an interface, which is just served/called by UdsTransportProtocolHandlers, which return TRUE from UdsTransportProtocolHandlers::isStartOfMessageIndicationSupported(). Header-Datei #include "apext/diag/uds_transport/protocol_mgr.h" class mono Scope class apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolMgr class mono Exception-Sicherheit exception safe class mono Thread-Sicherheit not thread-safe class mono Parameter (in) th Parameter th Beschreibung td sourceAddr td UDS source address of the message. td targetAddr td UDS target address of the message. td type td Indication whether the request is kPhysical or kFunctional addressed. td globalChannelId td Transport Protocol Channel on which the message start happened. td size td Size in bytes of the UdsMessage starting from SID. td payloadInfo td View onto the first received payload bytes, if any. This view shall be used only within this function call. It is recommended that the Transport Protocol provides at least the first two bytes of the request message, so the DM can identify a functional Tester Present. Lifetime: Valid until Promise is fulfilled or the processing is cancelled by the cancellationHandler. Rückgabewert th Typ th Beschreibung td std::pair< IndicationResult , UdsMessagePtr > td Pair of IndicationResult and a pointer to UDS Message owned/created by DM core and returned to the handler to get filled.
